news.raw_snippet: # Upscale AI Targets Staggering $2B Valuation in Latest Funding Frenzy | Bitcoinworld on Binance Square. BitcoinWorld![Image 7](https://public.bnbstatic.com/static/content/square/images/76a0d4fb26ec4df09b113b5f5cf2302f.jpg)Upscale AI Targets Staggering $2B Valuation in Latest Funding Frenzy. San Francisco, CA — April 16, 2026 — The artificial intelligence infrastructure sector is witnessing another meteoric rise as Upscale AI, a startup yet to launch a commercial product, engages in advanced talks to secure a funding round that would value the company at approximately $2 billion. Upscale AI is an AI infrastructure company reportedly focused on developing custom semiconductor chips (ASICs) and the full-stack software and networking systems required to make them work effectively at scale for artificial intelligence workloads. While companies like Nvidia and AMD provide general-purpose AI chips (GPUs), Upscale AI appears to be betting on custom, specialized chips paired with open-standards software.
